sn46.22:1.1: “Bhikkhus, I will teach you the seven factors of enlightenment.
sn46.22:1.3: “And what, bhikkhus, are the seven factors of enlightenment?
sn46.22:1.4: The enlightenment factor of mindfulness … the enlightenment factor of equanimity.
sn46.22:1.5: These are the seven factors of enlightenment.”
